baseline_models.focus_anchor: نحن خلقناهم وشددنا أسرهم ... بدلنا أمثالهم تبديلا
baseline_models.mechanism: Creation measures and brings a body into form; strengthening fastens its joints into a coherent whole; emphatic substitution can then put equally formed counterparts in place of the present bearers. Bodily stability is conferred rather than self-owned, so it does not entail irreplaceability.

activation_trace.role: Measuring and proportioning supplies the design stage of the assembled body.
Fastening a bond supplies the operation that makes the designed parts hold together.
Strength of bodily frame and joints identifies what the fastening stabilizes.
Replacement puts one person or thing in another's position and gives the repeated verbal noun operational force.
Likeness and counterparting specify that replacement preserves a recognizable human type.

changed_reading.before: The ayah is a bare threat that the current people can be removed.
changed_reading.after: The threat is grounded in manufacture: the same agency that proportions and fastens their viable frames can install equally formed counterparts in their place.

baseline_models.mechanism: A second branch of بدل changes a thing's form while its substance remains, while مثل can be a formed representation or model. Joined to a completed bodily frame, the clause can carry a live secondary possibility of re-forming an embodied instance after another pattern, not only exchanging one population for another.

activation_trace.role: Complete, proportioned form establishes bodily morphology as the object under discussion.
The joined bodily frame supplies a persistent substrate whose configuration may change.
Alteration of form without necessarily importing a substitute opens the reconfiguration branch.
A representation made after a model supplies the pattern according to which form can be renewed.

changed_reading.before: بدلنا أمثالهم can only mean removing these people and importing other people.
changed_reading.after: Alongside personal substitution, the wording leaves a branch-level possibility of reconfiguring embodied form according to a corresponding model.

baseline_models.mechanism: The same sequence can be heard socially: a tether is tightened around capturable subjects, and one set of bound counterparts can succeed another. This does not cancel the bodily-frame reading; it makes bodily dependence and political captivity overlap.

activation_trace.role: Fastening a bond supplies the tightening action.
Binding by tether and holding captive makes أسرهم audible as restraint as well as anatomy.
Person-for-person substitution turns restraint into succession of dependent subjects.
Counterpart likeness keeps the successors within the same dependent human class.

changed_reading.after: It may also cast created people as tethered subjects whose apparent autonomy is as replaceable as their bodily frame.

context_deltas.mechanism: The opening supplies a production sequence: an unmentioned knowable thing becomes a created mixed drop, is tested, and is made into a perceiving agent. That sequence turns the focus claim from abstract power into a demonstrated process capable of producing another embodied, accountable instance.

activation_trace.role: Measured creation anchors the delta in the focus ayah's production claim.
The bodily frame is the stabilized output of the opening developmental process.
Substitution names the repeatability inferred from that production process.
The knowable thing marks the starting contrast: the human had not yet been a mentioned entity.
Originating and bringing into being begins the demonstrated manufacture of the human.
The drop or reproductive fluid supplies the small material input.
Mixing and interpenetration make the input composite rather than already finished.
Testing that reveals a condition gives the produced frame an accountable function.
Making something assume a state carries the mixed material into hearing and sight.

structural_cues: Ayat 76:1-3 move from non-mention through mixed material and testing to a guided chooser; 76:28 restates creation, cohesion, and possible replacement in reverse compression.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the developmental sequence and the focus supplies replacement; I infer that a demonstrated production process can be repeated. A live alternative is that the opening proves only first creation while replacement means social succession.

changed_reading.before: Replacement is an unsupported assertion of power over an already existing group.
changed_reading.after: Replacement is backed by the surah's prior production run: mixed matter can again be configured into a coherent, perceptive, test-bearing counterpart.

context_deltas.mechanism: Chains and limb-binding collars establish coercive restraint, while the righteous feed a captive rather than exploit dependence. When the focus later says that God tightened أسرهم, anatomical cohesion and captivity become a deliberate double exposure: every captor and captive is itself held together under a higher agency and can be replaced.

activation_trace.role: Fastening a bond anchors the focus wording in the restraint mechanism.
The focus root's captive branch permits the social reading without displacing bodily cohesion.
Person-for-person replacement makes dependence reversible across cohorts.
Connected rings supply the explicit apparatus of serial restraint.
A collar that binds a limb makes tightened attachment bodily and punitive at once.
Feeding another supplies the ethical action toward a dependent body.
The explicit captive reactivates the same tether-and-captivity branch carried by أسرهم.

structural_cues: The surah places punitive chains in 76:4, compassionate feeding of a captive in 76:8, and the same root inside the Creator's bodily claim in 76:28.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the restraint lexicon and its ethical reversal; I infer that 76:28 turns the relation reflexive by making all human holders and held bodies dependent on divine fastening. The live alternative is that أسرهم is purely anatomical and only contrasts accidentally with أسيرا.

changed_reading.before: The verse describes either anatomy or punishment, requiring a choice between them.
changed_reading.after: It can make anatomy itself the higher-order bond: those who bind or release others remain created, fastened subjects whose cohort is contingent.

context_deltas.mechanism: The reward scene repeatedly combines mixtures, containers, material, transparency, and exact measure. That crafted system activates the focus body's joined frame as a calibrated vessel and strengthens the secondary بدل branch in which form is altered or remade according to a model.

activation_trace.role: Proportioning supplies the design relation between body and measured vessel.
The cohesive frame functions as the container that keeps a composition viable.
Transformation with continuing substance supplies the remanufacture possibility.
A formed representation supplies the pattern for a like vessel or body.
The branch of bodily temperament and composition lets the drink mixture activate an embodied mixture.
The vessel branch supplies a bounded receiver for the measured composition.
Silver supplies the material from which the unusual transparent vessels are described.
The glass-container branch supplies visible form and containment.
Fitting a thing to its measure supplies exact calibration rather than bulk manufacture.

structural_cues: Ayat 76:15-18 place silver, glasslike containers, repeated measuring, a mixed drink, and a named spring in one material sequence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies measured vessels and mixtures; I supply the body-as-container analogy linking them to أسرهم and the transformation branch of بدل. A live alternative is that the calibration describes reward service only and does not revise human morphology.

changed_reading.before: Replacement means only exchanging complete people as indivisible units.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, it also evokes the maker's capacity to remeasure and refashion the bounded form through which a human composition is held.

context_deltas.mechanism: The youths are visually encountered, cognitively reckoned, and rendered as scattered pearls. This trains likeness as a relation between an embodied group and a repeatable visible pattern, allowing أمثالهم to preserve recognizable configuration without requiring numerical identity.

activation_trace.role: Representation or image anchors the focus counterpart in patterned appearance.
Substitution turns repeated pattern into a succession of concrete bearers.
Direct seeing establishes the perceptual input from which likeness is formed.
Supposition converts the seen group into a judged resemblance.
Pearls supply the repeated units of the comparison.
Scattering distributes like units into a visible collective pattern.

structural_cues: 76:19 explicitly stages the sequence observer, sight, cognitive likeness, repeated units, and spatial distribution.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a worked visual simile; I infer that it primes أمثالهم as pattern-preserving counterparts. The live alternative is that the pearl comparison is local ornament and supplies no model for replacement.

changed_reading.before: Their likes are biological duplicates defined only by category membership.
changed_reading.after: Their likes may be new bearers of a recognizable created pattern, as a distributed group can instantiate one apprehended image without being the original units.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later sequence evaluates striving, forbids obedience to corrupt agents, identifies 'these' by their love of the immediate, and reopens a path to the Lord. The plural object of creation and replacement is therefore not bare biomass but agents located by attachments and actions; the human pattern persists while its current bearers are contingent.

activation_trace.role: Person-for-person substitution anchors succession in the focus clause.
Following a model or command lets counterparting acquire a conduct-bearing dimension.
An extended traversable path supplies the available orientation after the replacement warning.
Love fixed in the heart identifies the present group's operative attachment.
Work and earned action establish the contrasting basis on which agents are evaluated.
Obedient compliance supplies the contested social direction of action.
Hastening and bringing forward make immediacy the temporal bias defining 'these people.'
Taking up a manner or form turns the offered path into enacted orientation.

structural_cues: 76:22 commends striving; 76:24 regulates obedience; 76:27 names the current plural by temporal love; 76:28 keeps that plural as object; 76:29 offers a path.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the conduct sequence and pronoun continuity; I infer that replacement concerns morally situated agents while likeness preserves the human template. A live alternative is a generic species-level threat with no claim about the replacements' conduct.

changed_reading.before: The focus verse concerns interchangeable organisms independently of what they do.
changed_reading.after: It addresses action-bearing agents: the created human type may continue in counterparts even as a cohort defined by love of immediacy proves nonessential.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus conditional 'when We will' begins a fourfold run: divine willing to replace, human willing to take a path, human willing bounded by divine willing, and divine willing to admit. The focus verse becomes the hinge that grounds offered agency in created and sustained contingency rather than an isolated destruction threat.

activation_trace.role: Will directed toward bringing about a thing launches the focus conditional.
Replacement is the concrete possible effect that demonstrates the reach of that will.
Human willing toward a path introduces a real but dependent choice immediately after the focus claim.
The paired human and divine occurrences explicitly nest one willing within the other.
Divine willing toward admission carries the hierarchy from possible replacement to final placement.

structural_cues: شاء recurs in every ayah from 76:28 through 76:31, alternating divine, human, paired, and divine subjects while the discourse moves from replacement to path-taking to admission.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the uninterrupted repetition and subject alternation; I infer that 76:28 is the material premise and hinge of the agency sequence. A live alternative is that each شاء is a locally independent formula joined only by rhetoric.

changed_reading.before: If We will is merely a condition attached to a threat of replacement.
changed_reading.after: It opens a nested account of agency: human path-taking is meaningful, yet the created frame, its continuance, and its eventual placement remain inside divine willing.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the womb and cut-cord branches beneath words ordinarily read as mercy and bodily frame. It remains anchored in خلقناهم, أسرهم, the non-dominant mapped branch for أسر, and the closing 'enter into His mercy.' Downstream prose should present it only as a cross-domain birth analogy, not as a lexical equation of mercy with a womb or a physiological claim.

activation_trace.role: Bringing into being supplies the first-birth side of the analogy.
The split root's navel and cut-cord image makes the strengthened frame retain a trace of gestational attachment.
Transformation rather than simple exchange supplies the possible re-formation.
Entering an interior supplies the directional movement into containment.
The womb branch supplies a protected generative interior as an exploratory image for mercy.

changed_reading.before: Creation and replacement end before the separate closing promise of admission into mercy.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the close can image mercy as re-containment by the same maker who first formed, joined, and can transform the human frame.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is branch-distant because it uses the packet's non-dominant س ر ي mapping for أسر and the water-hollow branch of خلق. It remains valid as a material analogy anchored in the focus body's strengthening and the surah's spring-and-gushing system. Downstream prose should label it speculative hydraulic imagery and should not replace the dominant joints or captivity senses with it.

activation_trace.role: A water-holding hollow supplies a bounded created container.
Fastening supplies the pressure-bearing stabilization of that container and its channels.
The split root's running stream and creeping flow image recasts the frame as a channel network.
Alteration of form allows the bounded channel system to be refashioned in a like configuration.
A running spring supplies the source node of the surah's hydraulic imagery.
Wide splitting and gushing supplies controlled release through the channel system.
Exact fitting to measure constrains the speculative system to calibrated rather than chaotic flow.

changed_reading.before: Strengthening the frame is only a static image of bones and joints.
changed_reading.after: As a contained outlier, it can also image a stabilized network of reservoirs and flows that the maker can reproduce or reconfigure in like form.

strongest_changes: The opening developmental sequence turns replacement into the repeatable production of coherent, perceptive, test-bearing agents.
Chains, collars, and the fed captive make أسرهم carry bodily cohesion and socially reversible restraint at once.
The uninterrupted شاء sequence makes 76:28 the material hinge in a nested account of human and divine willing.
Precisely measured vessels and mixtures keep a secondary transformation reading alive beside straightforward person-for-person substitution.
summary.what_was_special: The whole-surah packet let the focus verse compress distant mechanisms: origin from mixed matter, restraint and care for captives, calibrated containers, visible patterning, morally located action, and the final alternation of wills. The split mappings for أسر also exposed birth and flow analogies that would disappear in a dominant-root-only reading.
remaining_uncertainties: The syntax of بدلنا أمثالهم most directly favors replacement by counterparts; it is uncertain how much weight the same-substance transformation branch can bear.
The repeated captive root strongly licenses an echo, but it remains uncertain whether the focus construction intentionally foregrounds social captivity or only bodily joints.
The patterned-appearance model may be no more than activation from a local simile.
The womb and hydraulic outliers depend on non-dominant or branch-distant mappings and should remain explicitly exploratory.
